tools.name: estimate_flood_premium
tools.description: Typical federal (NFIP) flood premium for homes like the one described, from policy-level data for covered coastal counties. Returns p25/p50/p75, policy count, and an 18%-cap projection. Not a quote.

tools.name: town_trend
tools.description: Median flood premium by year and policies in force for a covered county or town, plus county non-renewal rates.

tools.name: insurance_context
tools.description: National coverage: homeowners premium, non-renewal rate and loss ratio by year for a ZIP (2018-2022), and/or county non-renewal rate by year (2018-2023).

tools.name: parcel_report
tools.description: Look up a Cape May County parcel by address. Returns tax assessment, FEMA flood zone, and — when an elevation certificate is on file — diagram number, lowest-floor elevation, BFE, freeboard in feet, certificate date, surveyor source, plus the town's published premium band for that freeboard with pol

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request_quotes" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Send a person's details to up to 3 licensed insurance agencies that write the ZIP, so they can contact the person about flood/homeowners coverage. Before callin…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "request_quotes" is 1104 chars, far longer than this server's median (198). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Send a person's details to up to 3 licensed insurance agencies that write the ZIP, so they can contact the person about flood/homeowners coverage. Before callin…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_quotes · Private data: parcel_report, request_quotes · Public sink: request_quotes.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_quotes · Private data: parcel_report, request_quotes · Public sink: request_quotes

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
